verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.72
8. Ānanda
A Disciple of the Ājīvakas

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṁ viharati ghositārāme.
verses.english: At one time Venerable Ānanda was staying near Kosambī, in Ghosita’s Monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro ājīvakasāvako gahapati yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so ājīvakasāvako gahapati āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then a householder who was a disciple of the Ājīvaka ascetics went up to Venerable Ānanda, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to Ānanda:
“Honorable Ānanda, whose teaching is well explained?
Who in the world is practicing well?
Who in the world has done well?”

verses.pali: “Tena hi, gahapati, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya tathā naṁ byākareyyāsi.
verses.english: “Well then, householder, I’ll ask you about this in return, and you can answer as you like.
What do you think, householder?

verses.pali: ye rāgassa pahānāya dhammaṁ desenti, dosassa pahānāya dhammaṁ desenti, mohassa pahānāya dhammaṁ desenti, tesaṁ dhammo svākkhāto no vā?
verses.english: Is the teaching of those who teach for giving up greed, hate, and delusion well explained or not?
Or how do you see this?”

verses.pali: “Ye, bhante, rāgassa pahānāya dhammaṁ desenti, dosassa pahānāya dhammaṁ desenti, mohassa pahānāya dhammaṁ desenti, tesaṁ dhammo svākkhāto.
verses.english: “The teaching of those who teach for giving up greed, hate, and delusion is well explained.
That’s how I see it.”
“What do you think, householder?

verses.pali: ye rāgassa pahānāya paṭipannā, dosassa pahānāya paṭipannā, mohassa pahānāya paṭipannā, te loke suppaṭipannā no vā?
verses.english: Are those who practice for giving up greed, hate, and delusion practicing well or not?
Or how do you see this?”

verses.pali: “Ye, bhante, rāgassa pahānāya paṭipannā, dosassa pahānāya paṭipannā, mohassa pahānāya paṭipannā, te loke suppaṭipannā.
verses.english: “Those who practice for giving up greed, hate, and delusion are practicing well.
That’s how I see it.”
“What do you think, householder?

verses.pali: yesaṁ rāgo pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅkato āyatiṁ anuppādadhammo, yesaṁ doso pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅkato āyatiṁ anuppādadhammo, yesaṁ moho pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅkato āyatiṁ anuppādadhammo, te loke sukatā no vā?
verses.english: Have those who’ve given up greed, hate, and delusion—so they’re cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, obliterated, and unable to arise in the future—done well in the world, or not?
Or how do you see this?”

verses.pali: “Yesaṁ, bhante, rāgo pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅkato āyatiṁ anuppādadhammo, yesaṁ doso pahīno …pe… yesaṁ moho pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅkato āyatiṁ anuppādadhammo, te loke sukatā.
verses.english: “Those who’ve given up greed, hate, and delusion have done well in the world.
That’s how I see it.”
“So, householder, you’ve declared:

verses.pali: ‘ye, bhante, rāgassa pahānāya dhammaṁ desenti, dosassa pahānāya dhammaṁ desenti, mohassa pahānāya dhammaṁ desenti, tesaṁ dhammo svākkhāto’ti.
verses.english: ‘The teaching of those who teach for giving up greed, hate, and delusion is well explained.’
And you’ve declared:

verses.pali: ‘ye, bhante, rāgassa pahānāya paṭipannā, dosassa pahānāya paṭipannā, mohassa pahānāya paṭipannā, te loke suppaṭipannā’ti.
verses.english: ‘Those who practice for giving up greed, hate, and delusion are practicing well.’
And you’ve declared:

verses.pali: ‘yesaṁ, bhante, rāgo pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅkato āyatiṁ anuppādadhammo, yesaṁ doso pahīno …pe… yesaṁ moho pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅkato āyatiṁ anuppādadhammo, te loke sukatā’”ti.
verses.english: ‘Those who’ve given up greed, hate, and delusion have done well in the world.’”
“It’s incredible, sir, it’s amazing!

verses.pali: Na ceva nāma sadhammukkaṁsanā bhavissati, na ca paradhammāpasādanā.
verses.english: There’s no acclaiming your own teaching or disrespecting someone else’s,

verses.pali: Āyataneva dhammadesanā, attho ca vutto, attā ca anupanīto.
verses.english: just teaching what’s relevant in that context. The goal is spoken of, but the self is not involved.

verses.pali: Tumhe, bhante ānanda, rāgassa pahānāya dhammaṁ desetha, dosassa …pe… mohassa pahanāya dhammaṁ desetha.
verses.english: You, sir, teach Dhamma for giving up greed, hate, and delusion.
Your teaching is well explained.

verses.pali: Tumhe, bhante ānanda, rāgassa pahānāya paṭipannā, dosassa …pe… mohassa pahānāya paṭipannā.
verses.english: You, sir, practice for giving up greed, hate, and delusion.
You in the world are practicing well.

verses.pali: Tumhākaṁ, bhante ānanda, rāgo pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅkato āyatiṁ anuppādadhammo, tumhākaṁ doso pahīno …pe… tumhākaṁ moho pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅkato āyatiṁ anuppādadhammo.
verses.english: You’ve given up greed, hate, and delusion.
You in the world have done well.
Excellent, sir! Excellent!

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhante, nikkujjitaṁ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṁ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṁ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṁ dhāreyya: ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī’ti; evamevaṁ ayyena ānandena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
verses.english: As if he were righting the overturned, or revealing the hidden, or pointing out the path to the lost, or lighting a lamp in the dark so people with clear eyes can see what’s there, Master Ānanda has made the teaching clear in many ways.

verses.pali: Esāhaṁ, bhante ānanda, taṁ bhagavantaṁ saraṇaṁ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
verses.english: I go for refuge to the Buddha, to the teaching, and to the mendicant Saṅgha.

verses.pali: Upāsakaṁ maṁ ayyo ānando dhāretu, ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: From this day forth, may Master Ānanda remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”
